text.tspan: National poverty line vs. median income or consumption per day2023
This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
Median income or expenditure per day (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Harmonized national poverty line (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Data source: Foster et al. (2025); World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)
Note: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Depending on the country and year, it relates to income (measured after taxes
